name: standing-stomach-vacuum
instructions:
1. In a standing position, place your hands overhead or on your sides and exhale all of the air from your lungs.
2. Once you’ve completely exhaled, think about trying to draw your belly button to your spine.
3. Hold for the desired amount of time and then repeat for assigned number of repetitions.
